cases.source_law_quote: Upon a highway which has been divided into three clearly marked lanes, a vehicle must not be driven in the extreme left lane at any time. A vehicle on such a highway must not be driven in the center lane except: (a) When overtaking and passing another vehicle where the highway is clearly visible and the center lane is clear of traffic for a safe distance; (b) In preparation for a left turn; or (c) When the center lane is allocated exclusively to traffic moving in the direction in which the vehicle is proceeding and a sign is posted to give notice of such allocation.
